race.comment: ALL SHOT (1) ran a nice race to finish second two back over this distance at Balaklava in a BM58. Took on Saturday metro company last start and struggled. Back in his right grade, draws a decent gate, and should be cherry ripe at the fourth run back from a spell. KORATORA (4) just failed in a bid to lead all the way two runs back over this distance at Strathalbyn. Just missed the placings over today's journey at Morphettville on Saturday which is excellent form for a race of this calibre. Top chance if they decide to back-up. LELIYN (3) failed at Morphettville recently after an eye-catching first-up effort at Gawler. Draws easily the best gate of three this prep and back in midweek company looks a serious contender. ATTAIN (2) doesn't win out of turn but wasn't far away in a BM62 at Horsham last start. That form should stack up nicely. Market watch on STYLISH SPARKLE (5) first-up from a nine-week lay-off with blinkers going on.
